title: Spec: integer endianness contradiction in hash inputs (2a.10.7 BE vs SelectChannel/CCP-12 LE)
description: Discovered during 3x codereview of hash_32 vector work (worker6-vlgs.2, Kimi K3 security pass). spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.10.7 rule 1 mandates big-endian integer serialization before hashing and makes hash_32.json normative, but SelectChannel (spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:193) specifies Epoch as LE u32 and CCP-12 (spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:161, test/validate_sync_hop.py:79) specifies CONCAT(Seed_LE, SFN_LE). spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:390 additionally states hashing a concatenation is non-conformant for slot selection. The spec must pick one canonical endianness/shape per hash input (BE serialization per 2a.10.7, or amend the rule) and align SelectChannel, CCP-12, and the design rationale. Note the existing ccp_select_channel_endianness.json vector family when resolving.
